chunks: We know well what they will say when the most upright among them will say: 'You did not tarry more than a day.'

key_terms.أَمْثَلُهُمْ: The most upright or best among them

ai.seo_question: What will the disbelievers say about the duration of their stay on the Day of Judgment according to Surah Taa-Haa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores Allah's omniscience regarding the deceptive rhetoric of the disbelievers, particularly the 'most eloquent' (amthaluhum) who attempt to minimize the duration of worldly life or the grave to downplay the weight of accountability. This minimization contrasts sharply with the eternal reality of the Hereafter, serving as a critique of those who use their rhetorical skills to obscure the truth of resurrection. The verse thus highlights the disparity between human perception of time and divine reality, reinforcing the inevitability of judgment.
